summary: Fixed the v2 titlebar branch so it renders a visible, aria-labeled navigation entry to /agentic (AgenticNavEntryV2, placed among the v2 left-side icon controls at titlebar.tsx:492, idiomatic to the v2 chrome). The prior coverage was vacuous: the e2e 'legacy layout' test waited for a legacy-only sidebar selector and never enabled/toggled newLayoutDesigns, and asserted a non-existent testid — so the v2 branch was never exercised while the suite claimed green. Added a failing-test-first component test (titlebar.test.tsx, renders the real AgenticNavEntryV2, asserts aria-label=sidebar.agentic + click navigates to /agentic; fails pre-fix because the component does not exist). Rewrote the e2e chrome-reachability spec to genuinely drive the layout fork (newLayoutDesigns ON vs OFF via localStorage init, real page.click in each mode, toggle-survival via in-app settings toggle). Unit suite + typecheck green. E2E execution is BLOCKED by a pre-existing, out-of-scope crash: AgenticCommands (packages/app/src/app.tsx:527,580-582) calls useCommand OUTSIDE CommandProvider (it is mounted as a sibling of ServerShell, which owns CommandProvider via SharedProviders), so the live app throws 'Command context must be used within a context provider' on first paint. This is a prior-run defect in app.tsx (not an owned file for this SR) and is reported for orchestrator disposition.
spec_review_note: Acceptance criteria met for the in-scope titlebar work: (1) visible v2 nav entry in the Match when={useV2Titlebar()} branch, idiomatic to v2 chrome, aria-label from i18n sidebar.agentic, <=2 interactions (1 click) — AgenticNavEntryV2 at titlebar.tsx:492; (2) legacy entries untouched (legacy titlebar button titlebar.tsx:660-668 and sidebar rail sidebar-shell.tsx unchanged); (3) unit/component coverage genuinely exercises the fork decision — titlebar.test.tsx renders the real v2 entry and asserts aria-label + navigation, fails pre-fix; (4) e2e spec rewritten to genuinely cover new-layout nav-entry visibility+navigation with newLayoutDesigns enabled + toggle-survival (real page.click, no reload); (5) unit suite + typecheck clean. AC5 'full e2e suite passes' is BLOCKED by a pre-existing app.tsx crash (see integration_testing_review), not by this SR's changes.
quality_review_note: AgenticNavEntryV2 is a small exported component (titlebar.tsx) matching the v2 idiom exactly: IconButtonV2 (variant=ghost-muted, size=large, !w-9 shrink-0) + TooltipV2 (placement=bottom) + terminal icon, mirroring the adjacent home button. aria-label and tooltip use language.t('sidebar.agentic'); onClick navigates to /agentic. Props accept language + navigate so the entry is renderable in isolation under test (no full provider tree needed). No stubs/TODOs/placeholders. The terminal glyph reuses the v1 <Icon name='terminal' size='small'> (the same glyph the legacy titlebar/sidebar entries use) because the v2 icon set (packages/ui, not an owned file) has no terminal icon — this gives visual consistency across layout modes without touching packages/ui.
real_not_stubbed_note: AgenticNavEntryV2 calls the real navigate('/agentic') (the same useNavigate handle the v2 branch already holds) and the real language.t('sidebar.agentic'). The unit test renders the real component with a mock navigate capture (to assert the call) and a language.t passthrough (returning the key, so the aria-label assertion is stable across locales); the real IconButtonV2/TooltipV2/Icon components render. The e2e uses real page.click and real URL assertions.
tests_note: TDD: wrote titlebar.test.tsx FIRST and watched it fail against the pre-fix code (AgenticNavEntryV2 did not exist → render threw 'undefined is not an object (evaluating args[0][$ELEMENT])' / component undefined; captured as the red state), then added the component and the test went green. Unit suite (bun 1.3.14, default server conditions): 658 pass, 13 skip (incl. the new titlebar test, which skipIf isServer), 0 fail across 671 tests. Browser conditions: titlebar.test.tsx 1 pass; test:agentic-terminal 48 pass; test:browser 29 pass. Typecheck (tsgo -b) clean; e2e typecheck (tsgo -p e2e/tsconfig.json) clean. New-layout test verified to FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix.

reuse_compliance_note: Extended the existing titlebar.tsx (no new chrome module) per D3 latitude for v2 sub-chrome. Reused the existing i18n key sidebar.agentic (present in all 21 locales — no i18n changes needed, verified). Reused the existing v1 terminal Icon glyph for cross-mode visual consistency. The e2e spec is the established suite file (not a new file). No new dependencies.

The new entry matches the v2 titlebar idiom exactly (same IconButtonV2 variant/size/class, same TooltipV2 placement, same icon-button spacing as the adjacent home button). No pixel spec applies.
test_completeness_review_note: Root cause of the vacuous prior coverage identified and fixed: (a) the e2e 'legacy layout' test waited for [data-component='sidebar-nav-desktop'] — a legacy-only selector — and never enabled or toggled newLayoutDesigns, so the v2 titlebar branch was never entered; (b) it asserted [data-testid='agentic-terminal-root'], a selector that does not exist in the source (the real testid is 'agentic-terminal'), so even the direct-route assertion was vacuous; (c) the prior review (6.json) claimed 'nav entry visible+functional new layout verified (titlebar.tsx:663-668)' but those lines are in the LEGACY Match branch — the claim was against the wrong branch. Fixed: the e2e now sets newLayoutDesigns deterministically (localStorage init), asserts the v2 titlebar slot [data-slot='titlebar-v2'] rendered (guarding against silent legacy fallback), and clicks the real aria-labeled button in each mode plus a toggle-survival path. The unit test renders the real v2 entry component and is gated skipIf(isServer) to match the package's browser-condition render-test idiom (panels-a.test.tsx precedent).
integration_testing_review_note: E2E spec is genuine and typechecks clean, but live execution is BLOCKED by a pre-existing crash in packages/app/src/app.tsx (NOT an owned file for this SR): AgenticCommands (app.tsx:527, mounted at app.tsx:580-582) calls useCommand() but is placed as a SIBLING of ServerShell inside the router root callback, OUTSIDE CommandProvider (which lives in SharedProviders inside ServerShell). On first paint the live app throws 'Command context must be used within a context provider at AgenticCommands' and the error boundary renders 'Something went wrong'. Verified against the running dev server (bun 1.3.14, SHELL stripped, port 3000): page snapshot shows the error boundary. This is a prior-run defect (review 6.json introduced AgenticCommands in app.tsx) and explains how the prior e2e 'passed' — it never actually ran against a booting app. Reported for orchestrator disposition; fixing app.tsx is outside this SR's owned files. Unit + typecheck are green and unaffected.

Legacy entries unchanged. Toggle-survival e2e path toggles newLayoutDesigns in-app (no reload) and re-verifies the entry in the newly-active shell.
